infectionStatus.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

value.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en: Uika Misumi, the charismatic guitarist-vocalist of Ave Mujica, as well as a member of the idol unit sumimi. Her hobbies include stargazing. Concern for Sakiko also appears to be a forefront preoccupation of hers.
text.zh: Ave Mujica的主唱兼吉他手三角初华。既是Mujica的成员，也是著名偶像组合sumimi的一员。拥有出众的个人魅力，爱好观星，总是把祥子挂在嘴边。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Uika Misumi shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] Undisclosed
The Medical Department has agreed not to disclose the relevant data.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
三角初华没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】未公开
根据医疗部决议，不公开相关数据。

text.en: With an infectiously bright smile and excellent communication skills, Uika Misumi has fit in well at Rhodes Island. Throughout her time diligently learning the ins-and-outs of working here, Uika has earned the trust of those aboard Rhodes just like the other members of Ave Mujica.
text.zh: 三角初华在罗德岛与大家相处时，展现出了特别的亲和力。她总是对大家笑颜相向，很快，大家就喜欢上了这样的初华。初华踏实耐心地学习着罗德岛上的事务，与Ave Mujica的其他同伴一起获得了干员们的信赖。

text.en:
Though she is only in her first year of high school, Uika has already made a successful debut as a member of sumimi, an idol group from her home country. A diligent hard worker, Uika has a wonderful voice and outstanding guitar skills, and also writes her own songs and lyrics. She was scouted for Ave Mujica by Sakiko.
As guitarist-vocalist of Ave Mujica, Uika gives her everything for the band, and her deep love for it is plain for everyone to see.
text.zh:
明明还只是高一的学生，初华就已经在故乡以偶像组合sumimi成员的身份出道，并且取得了不小的成就。她有着极其美妙的歌喉、娴熟的吉他技巧，还能够自己作词作曲，在多个方面刻苦学习提高自己。后来，初华受到祥子的邀请，加入了Ave Mujica。
成为Mujica主唱的初华，无论何时都为乐队贡献着自己的全部力量，大家都能看出来，她是真的爱着这个乐队。

text.en:
Uika and Sakiko are childhood friends, which is the reason Uika joined the band. To Uika, Sakiko is more than just a friend; she is someone Uika has always aspired after.
At Rhodes Island, the pair often go up to the deck to watch the stars. Though the night sky of Terra is strange and unfamiliar, when shared with Sakiko, there could be nothing more beautiful to Uika.
text.zh:
初华与祥子自小便相识，也是得益于这一层关系，祥子才能邀请到初华加入乐队。对于初华来说，祥子不仅仅是她的好友，也是她一直以来憧憬的目标。
她们两人在罗德岛时，喜欢在夜间来到甲板上，一起看星星。泰拉的星空如此陌生，但是在这一刻的初华眼里，它也是最珍贵的美景。

text.en: We have noticed that Uika seems to put up certain subtle barriers in her interactions with us. It is not that she is not being sincere, but there is a sense that she is intentionally refraining from expressing her opinion. Compared to taking about her own thoughts, she seems to prefer to know about what Sakiko thinks. Uika's feelings toward Sakiko are more than just care or aspiration; there seem to be deeper, darker feelings within.
text.zh: 在与Ave Mujica的成员们接触的过程中，我们发现初华与他人之间总会有一种淡淡的距离感。当然这并不是指初华不是一个真诚的人，而是说，她好像不太知道要怎样展现自己的真实想法。比起说出自己所想，她总是更想要了解祥子所想。她对祥子除了关切和憧憬，似乎还有一些晦暗不明的感情。

text.en:
[Iris's Notes]
Uika has spent her life living in guilt. Though she stands by Sakiko's side, where she has always longed to be, her heart remains trapped in the past. When she feared that telling the truth would destroy the relationship they had, she found herself paralyzed in place.
When Sakiko was in pain, Uika believed that it was her and her lies who caused that pain to Sakiko, and that there was nothing Uika could do to help her. The end result was that she could not be there by Sakiko's side to support her.
One day, Uika will understand that she cannot simply hide her true feelings beneath a perfect smile. There will come a time when she must face herself.
Uika will not remember all that transpired on Terra when she wakes from the dream. But perhaps, a part of her experiences here will stay with her and give her courage—
The courage to face her own sorrow, and to move forward.
text.zh:
【爱丽丝记录】
初华一直活在内疚中。她明明已经站在了自己最向往的地方，站在了祥子的身边，但她还是无法放下过去。她害怕现状会被打破，所以她选择止步不前。
在祥子陷入痛苦时，她不敢靠近，因为她消极地认为自己的关心毫无作用。她觉得自己是骗子，是给祥子带来痛苦的元凶。
总有一天，她会明白，自己不能只是展现完美无瑕的笑容给身边的人。她是她自己，不是其他人，她不能永远隐藏起真正的自己。
当初华醒来时，她不会记得在泰拉发生的一切。但是我们希望在这里的经历能化作她潜意识里的勇气——
让她去直面自己的过去和悲伤，并且向前迈进的勇气。
